newsitem.title: USA: Enserch sees Q1 asset writeoff on price dip.
newsitem.headline: Enserch sees Q1 asset writeoff on price dip.

text.p: ENSERCH Corp said the 1996 10-K filed Friday by its 83 percent-owned exploration and production subsidiary, Enserch Exploration Inc, indicated recent declines in natural gas and oil prices are likely to require Enserch Exploration to write down its total assets at the end of the first quarter under full cost accounting.

Although final calculations will not be completed until April, Enserch Exploration estimates the write-down will range from $225 to $250 million after tax, or about $190 to $210 million to ENSERCH Corp's interest, the company said.
"This write-down will not affect the pending merger of ENSERCH Corp with Texas Utilities Co, as EEX will be an entirely independent, stand-alone entity," ENSERCH Corp said.
